title_zh: 约定展览合作先核对开幕日期

scenario.label_zh: 约定展览合作先核对开幕日期
scenario.goal_zh: 发现拟议开幕与会员晚会撞期，并分工询问能否调整后再决定联合开幕

context_zh: 两家小型美术馆的工作人员讨论尚未确定的合作展览。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Are we still hoping to collaborate with the Riverside Gallery on an opening event?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Yes, but their proposed date would coincide with our annual members evening.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Could your counterpart there check whether the following Friday is free?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: I'll ask her. Would our director accept a later opening?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: I'll check with him today. The collaboration could work, but we shouldn't announce a date before both galleries agree.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Right. Let's compare their replies tomorrow before choosing the opening night.

targets.sense_zh: 另一机构中职务相对应的人
